pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: A large retail brand runs a personalization engine that serves product recommendations to users across its website, email, and mobile app. They want to use a generative AI layer — meaning an AI that produces new text or content rather than just retrieving pre-written options — to create individualized marketing messages at scale. They're also operating under tightening data privacy regulations that limit how long they can retain individual-level behavioral data. How would you design the measurement framework to evaluate whether the generative personalization layer is actually driving incremental revenue — and how does your approach change when you can't rely on persistent user-level tracking?
